draft.summary: The tee.redpill.ai coverage_lost event compares a 2026-10-13 legacy adapter 'verified' row with a 2026-10-14 current 'not_checked' row. The newer verifier requires boot-measurement and request-path proof that the older result did not establish. Captured gateway quote, nonce, keyset, event-log and compose fields support several narrower bindings, but do not complete those missing checks. This is primarily an instrument-scope downgrade, not evidence that the provider changed to a compromised deployment. The three ACI hosts share one observed gateway workload; zero full-valid adapter results do not imply three compromised providers.

review.rationale: Confirmed immutable report/raw-evidence integrity, unchanged reported compose identity and the new explicit boot/request proof gap. The coverage event primarily corrects the instrument claim; it does not demonstrate a compromised deployment. The reported keyset change remains a separate unproven continuity question. Retain not_checked, do not expand accepted references, and verify boot measurements plus a bound backend request before a full-route claim.
